title: How to sum values where a checkbox is checked
task: Total only the ticked rows — selected expenses, chosen items, approved amounts.
keywords: sum if checkbox checked google sheets

libreoffice.note: Same idea; LibreOffice writes the boolean criterion as TRUE().

explanation: Checkboxes store TRUE/FALSE, so SUMIF with TRUE as the criterion totals just the ticked rows: 100 + 25 = 125. Since TRUE behaves as 1, =SUMPRODUCT(A2:A100*B2:B100) gives the same answer and extends naturally to more conditions. Pair with the count-checked-checkboxes recipe for a live "3 selected · $125" summary line.
